name: Catalyst Canvas
status: open-source strategic design and problem-framing workspace
layers: workspace-scoped Flask project registry and immutable revision storage
evidence-aware persona, empathy-map, stakeholder, journey, and behavioral-signal studio
six reusable persona templates and research comparison workflows
automatic Canvas Contract 1.0 and legacy SQLite migration
WordPress browser-local project and research workspace
stable JSON, Markdown, and print-report exporters
method_path: challenge -> designated audiences -> persona jobs/needs/pains/gains -> observed versus assumed attributes -> empathy map -> stakeholder influence/interest/impact -> journey questions/frictions/opportunities/evidence/experiments -> behavioral hints -> POV -> HMW -> prototype -> test -> review
compatibility_note: python/catalyst_canvas_core.py and python/catalyst_canvas_brief.py are deprecated adapters over the catalyst_canvas package
storage_model: workspaces -> projects -> immutable canvas revisions + reusable persona/stakeholder/journey assets
behavioral_signal_boundary: Analytics and GA4 CSV rows are evidence hints only and cannot create identity, intent, motivation, or demographic claims.
